### Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(readr)   # read_csv: the *_sigs_merged.csv files written by 06_join_annotation are comma-separated
```


### Load DEGS
```{r}
# Gill (TC)
GOW_sigs <- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/GOW_sigs_merged.csv"))
GOA_sigs <- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/GOA_sigs_merged.csv"))
GDO_sigs <- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/GDO_sigs_merged.csv"))

# Foot (TC)
FOW_sigs <- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/FOW_sigs_merged.csv"))
FOA_sigs <- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/FOA_sigs_merged.csv"))
FDO_sigs <- read_csv(file.path(deg, "GOterms_genome/FDO_sigs_merged.csv"))

# Select only unique identifiers
GOW_sigs <- unique(GOW_sigs)
GOA_sigs <- unique(GOA_sigs)
GDO_sigs <- unique(GDO_sigs)

FOW_sigs <- unique(FOW_sigs)
FOA_sigs <- unique(FOA_sigs)
FDO_sigs <- unique(FDO_sigs)


```


```{r}
my_theme <- theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color="black",angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
        axis.title.x = element_text(color="black",size = 20),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color="black",size = 20),      
        axis.text.y = element_text(color="black",size = 18),
       legend.text = element_text(color="black",size = 18),      # Change legend text size
    legend.title = element_text(color="black",size = 20),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1))+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```

```{r}
# One row per gene: the merged tables repeat a DEG for each annotation row it matched
sigs <- list(GOA = GOA_sigs, GOW = GOW_sigs, GDO = GDO_sigs, FOA = FOA_sigs, FOW = FOW_sigs, FDO = FDO_sigs)
sigs <- lapply(sigs, function(x) distinct(x, gene, log2FoldChange, padj))
stopifnot(all(vapply(sigs, function(x) !anyDuplicated(x$gene), TRUE)))

# Shared axes, set from the data so that no DEG falls outside them (ggplot drops such points)
y_max <- ceiling(max(vapply(sigs, function(x) max(-log10(x$padj)), 0)))
x_max <- max(6, ceiling(max(vapply(sigs, function(x) max(abs(x$log2FoldChange)), 0))))

panel_title <- c(GOA = "Gill: OA vs control", GOW = "Gill: OW vs control", GDO = "Gill: DO vs control",
                 FOA = "Foot: OA vs control", FOW = "Foot: OW vs control", FDO = "Foot: DO vs control")

volcano <- function(code, y_label = NULL) {
  ggplot(sigs[[code]], aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = log2FoldChange > 0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = DIRECTION_COLORS[["down"]], "TRUE" = DIRECTION_COLORS[["up"]])) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s\n%d up, %d down", panel_title[[code]],
                         sum(sigs[[code]]$log2FoldChange > 0), sum(sigs[[code]]$log2FoldChange < 0)),
         x = expression(Log["2"]*" fold change"), y = y_label) +
    my_theme +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-x_max, x_max), ylim = c(1, y_max))
}
y_lab <- expression(-log["10"]*" adjusted p")
```

```{r}
g <- grid.arrange(volcano("GOA", y_lab), volcano("GOW"), volcano("GDO"), nrow = 1)
ggsave(file.path(figs, "TC_volcano_gill.png"), g, width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
```{r}
g <- grid.arrange(volcano("FOA", y_lab), volcano("FOW"), volcano("FDO"), nrow = 1)
ggsave(file.path(figs, "TC_volcano_foot.png"), g, width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
